name: West Virginia State University
academic_ranking: West Virginia State University is a public, historically black (HBCU), land-grant university founded in 1891 in Institute, WV. Total enrollment ~3,458 (2023), including ~2,095 undergraduates. No specific national academic ranking confirmed from a live source during research (checked 2026-07).
financial_aid: Approximately 48% of students received Pell grants per publicly available data. Specific annual tuition figures and detailed aid packages were not confirmed from a live official source during research (checked 2026-07); prospective recruits should confirm with the WVSU financial aid office and athletics compliance for scholarship/aid details.
facilities_notes: Softball home venue is Lady Jackets Field (listed among WVSU athletic facilities). Additional facility details not published on the softball program pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in the Mountain East Conference. Detailed program history/achievements were not populated on the softball program pages checked 2026-07.
notes: Data sourced live from wvsuyellowjackets.com softball staff and roster pages (checked 2026-07).
